strategy.name: qqq_dual_raw_stochrsi_cross_supergrid_heatmaps_2000_2015
strategy.description: Use only 2000–2015 to scan every valid integer pair with short StochRSI period 2 through 70, long period 50 through 150, and short strictly below long. Period zero is undefined and period one is a degenerate zero-width StochRSI window; both are excluded by the shared indicator contract. The fixed raw dual-StochRSI 0.20/0.80 CROSS rule and candidate-specific first-entry-aligned Buy & Hold comparator are unchanged.
strategy.buy_rule: While flat, both completed prior StochRSI values are below 0.20 and both provisional same-session values cross to or above 0.20; buy at the larger joint solved trigger.
strategy.sell_rule: While long, both completed prior StochRSI values are above 0.80 and both provisional same-session values cross to or below 0.80; sell at the smaller joint solved trigger.
strategy.signal_time: Eligibility and exact trigger prices use completed prior data only; every scoring window ends no later than 2015-12-31.
strategy.execution_time: Gaps beyond the trigger fill at Open; otherwise only the directed Open-to-Close path may fill at the exact trigger. High and Low are ignored.
strategy.positioning: Every window is a separate long-only 0%/100% QQQ account with 100000 dollars, fractional shares, no leverage, and no cash interest. Strategy and aligned benchmark both wait in cash until the strategy's first fill.

plain_language.summary: 把短周期和长周期扩展到一个很大的有效整数网格，直接观察收益与稳健性参数面。
plain_language.buy: 两个周期先同时处于低位，随后一起向上越过0.20时买入QQQ。
plain_language.sell: 两个周期先同时处于高位，随后一起向下跌破0.80时卖出QQQ。
plain_language.execution: 前一日收盘后冻结触发价；跳空越线按开盘价成交，否则只按开盘到收盘方向检查精确触发价。
plain_language.position: 策略和对照都先持有现金；策略第一次实际买入时，对照用相同资金和相同含成本成交价一次买入并持有。

benchmark: Candidate- and window-specific first-entry-aligned Buy & Hold QQQ: cash until the strategy's first actual buy fill, then all-in at that same cost-inclusive fill price and hold; no signal means cash throughout

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged and render four full-grid heatmaps for robustness, gate count, median CAGR, and median Sharpe.

research.hypothesis: A much wider valid integer grid will show whether the apparent high-CAGR ridges and locally robust areas are isolated artifacts or coherent structures across the full short/long period plane.
research.primary_metric: Descriptive four-surface map of maximin robustness, passed gate count, median CAGR, and median Sharpe over all valid pairs.
research.selection_rule: Score all 6738 valid pairs at 5 bps on 132 quarterly left-aligned 3/5/7-year windows ending by 2015. Apply the same seven frozen gates and ranking rule, but treat any champion label as secondary to the requested full surfaces.
research.validation_plan: Reconcile the selected champion or strongest near-miss plus 17/97, 30/143, and 42/100 over all 132 windows at 5 bps. Verify all four heatmaps contain exactly the valid triangular grid and mask invalid short>=long cells.
research.promotion_criteria: This is an exploratory map; no parameter advances without a separately frozen out-of-sample test and an absolute excess-CAGR requirement.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any period zero cell, short>=long cell, post-2015 leakage, incomplete grid, ledger mismatch, missing heatmap, or report that hides failed gates.
research.leakage_guard: No dates after 2015-12-31 are loaded into scoring windows or candidate ranking.
